subject: Hosted API provisioning sprint & burst credit orchestration
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Cole <hannah@cartica.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API provisioning sprint & burst credit orchestration

Hi Hannah —

Great to see Cartica's growth this quarter. Based on the usage patterns you shared, we put together a short onramp plan to cover the next 12 months and ensure you don’t hit hard throttles during upcoming campaign spikes. High level:

- Monthly committed tokens: move from current 750M -> 1.5B (prorated for Nov)
- Soft-burst credit: additional 50% burst pool for two months to cover seasonal spikes
- Rate band smoothing: temporary increase in per-minute TPS for the first 30 days of the ramp

I attached a sketch of the financial impact and the ops checklist for onboarding. If you’re comfortable, I can convert this to a formal proposal and draft a DocuSign for signatures. Key asks from your side: confirm the desired start date (Nov 1 or Nov 15) and whether procurement needs an itemized rate sheet.

Thanks — let me know if you want to jump on a quick 20-minute call tomorrow to walk through the numbers.

Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0186

Attachments: Cartica_PROPOSAL_draft.pdf (pdf), capacity_pricing_sheet.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Hannah Cole <hannah@cartica.com>

Cc: Cartica Procurement <procurement@procurement.cartica.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Oct 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API provisioning sprint & burst credit orchestration

Thanks Rafael — this looks promising. Quick clarifying Qs before we proceed:

1) How do the soft-burst credits apply during the month? Are they consumed before overage billing, or billed separately?
2) For the temporary TPS increase, what SLOs do you guarantee during the smoothing window?
3) Procurement asked if you can provide an SLA summary and a single-page price table we can share internally (finance + engineering).

We’d prefer a Nov 1 start if we can get approvals in time. Happy to take a 20-minute call Friday morning (our time) to close details.

—Hannah
Director of Product, Cartica
hannah@cartica.com | +1 (212) 555-4242

Date: Fri, 20 Oct 2028 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Hosted API provisioning sprint & burst credit orchestration — negotiation posture

Team —

Saw Hannah’s questions. Suggested negotiation posture and concession framework:

- Soft-burst credits: offer 50% additional burst for first 2 months, consumed before overage but capped (no unlimited consumption). This is a commercial concession; we should tie it to a 12-month committed term at 1.5B/mo.
- TPS smoothing: guarantee 95th percentile latency SLAs during the 30-day smoothing window with fallback to a slightly higher model variant if infra contention occurs. Ops will own the fallback runbook.
- Pricing: provide a single-page price table + SLA summary. Also include a prorated invoice for Nov to align start date.

Can confirm the above as long as we attach the ops runbook and draft DocuSign that captures the burst cap. Rafael — if you want, I’ll edit the draft proposal and attach the redwood_sla_summary.xlsx.

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

(Internal) Please flag any margin or precedent concerns — Karthik, anything to call out from a rate-tier perspective?

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Cole <hannah@cartica.com>
Cc: Cartica Procurement <procurement@cartica.cartica.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Oct 2028 11:44:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Hosted API provisioning sprint & burst credit orchestration

Hannah — thanks for the quick turnaround. Apologies for a small DocuSign hiccup on the procurement address in the cc — corrected now. Answers inline: 

1) Soft-burst credits: These are applied as a pre-paid buffer. Consumption reduces the remaining burst pool first; only after that will standard overage rates apply. We will capture the burst cap in the contract (50% of committed monthly tokens for Nov+Dec).

2) TPS / SLO: We’ll guarantee a 95th percentile latency SLA of 320ms for the smoothing window. If hardware contention threatens the SLA, we’ll automatically route to a fallback compatible model variant (same cost tier) for the affected requests; ops will notify you via the console and email. Full runbook attached.

3) SLA summary & price table: attached as requested (redwood_sla_summary.xlsx) and an updated proposal (Cartica_PROPOSAL_v2.pdf). I’ve also created a DocuSign envelope to capture the commitment and the burst cap: https://docusign.net/embeddedSigning/abcdef123456

I’ve included a single prorated line for Nov (start date Nov 1) in the proposal. If that looks good, we’ll send the envelope to procurement and copy your finance contact.

Best —
Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0186

Attachments: Cartica_PROPOSAL_v2.pdf (pdf), redwood_sla_summary.xlsx (xlsx)
